title: Dating App Privacy Policy Template - Protect Your Data
metaDescription: Comprehensive privacy policy template for dating apps. Cover data collection, location sharing, photo protection & user safety standards.
description: A complete privacy policy template specifically designed for dating applications. Covers data collection, location sharing, photo handling, user safety measures, and compliance requirements for dating platforms.

sections.heading: Information We Collect
sections.content: This section outlines the types of personal information collected from dating app users, including profile data, location information, photos, messages, and device information. We collect information you provide directly (profile details, photos, preferences), information from your use of our service (matches, messages, app interactions), and information from third parties (social media logins, background checks if applicable). Location data may be collected to show distance between users and enable location-based matching features.

sections.heading: How We Use Your Information
sections.content: We use collected information to provide and improve our dating services, including creating and managing user profiles, facilitating matches and connections, enabling communication between users, providing customer support, and ensuring platform safety through fraud detection and prevention. We may also use information for marketing purposes, service analytics, and compliance with legal requirements. Location data is used specifically for distance-based matching and may be shared with potential matches as approximate distance only.

sections.heading: Information Sharing and Disclosure
sections.content: We share limited information with other users as part of the dating service functionality, including profile information, photos you choose to share, and approximate location for distance display. We may share information with service providers who assist in app operations, law enforcement when legally required, and in connection with business transfers. We do not sell personal information to third parties for marketing purposes. Users have control over what profile information is visible to other users through privacy settings.

sections.heading: Location Privacy and Safety
sections.content: Location information is handled with special care for user safety. We collect location data to enable distance-based matching but never share exact location coordinates with other users. Location is displayed as approximate distance only (e.g., '2 miles away'). Users can control location sharing through device settings and app privacy controls. We implement additional safety measures for users in regions where dating app usage may pose personal safety risks, including options to hide precise location and enhanced privacy controls.

sections.heading: Photo and Media Protection
sections.content: Photos and media uploaded to profiles are protected against unauthorized use and sharing. We implement technical measures to prevent easy downloading or screenshot detection where possible. Users maintain ownership of their photos and can delete them at any time. We prohibit other users from copying, sharing, or using profile photos outside the platform. Violations of photo privacy policies result in account suspension or termination. We recommend users avoid uploading overly revealing or identifiable photos that could compromise their privacy.

sections.heading: User Safety and Security Measures
sections.content: We implement comprehensive safety measures to protect users from harassment, catfishing, and other harmful behaviors. This includes profile verification options, reporting and blocking tools, AI-powered content moderation, and investigation of reported safety concerns. Users can report suspicious profiles or inappropriate behavior through in-app reporting tools. We maintain a dedicated safety team to review reports and take appropriate action. Additional safety features may include photo verification, background check integration, and safe meeting recommendations.

sections.heading: Data Retention and Deletion
sections.content: User data is retained only as long as necessary to provide services and comply with legal obligations. When users delete their accounts, profile information and photos are permanently removed from our servers within [TIME_PERIOD]. Some information may be retained longer for safety reasons, such as records of reported violations or legal compliance. Users can request data deletion at any time through account settings or by contacting customer support. We provide data portability options allowing users to download their personal information before account deletion.

sections.heading: Your Privacy Rights and Controls
sections.content: Users have comprehensive control over their privacy and data. This includes the ability to control profile visibility, manage location sharing settings, block or report other users, download personal data, delete accounts and associated data, and opt out of marketing communications. Users can access and modify their information through account settings. We provide clear instructions for using privacy controls and regularly update these features based on user feedback and safety requirements. Additional privacy tools may include incognito browsing modes and enhanced privacy settings for sensitive user groups.
